text:
alejandro.mora: Heads-up: we're opening a small RTX8000 Dedicated preview in Santiago (sa-scl-1) for Chilean customers and nearby AP/LatAm partners. Pilot starts now — limited nodes, guided onboarding. :rocket:

min.park: Nice. What are the reservation and billing rules for the preview?

alejandro.mora: Preview policy: 10-day reservation window available, no SLA, billing at standard dedicated rates. Effective per-unit cost may be higher until we scale. Cancellation within 24h triggers an internal reallocation fee.

infra-bot: [automated] pool-create: dedicated-rtx8000-sa-scl-1-01 created (12x RTX8000). Monitoring: enabled.

sre-oncall: Ops note: pools are soft-fairshare. Non-reserved workloads may be reclaimed during peak reclamation events. Autoscaling disabled for preview.

sales-latam: Can we promise throughput or latency numbers to customers?

alejandro.mora: For preview, provide "best-effort" guidance. We'll post p50/p95 latency and token throughput after 48h telemetry. Recommend customers reserve for production parity.

infra-bot: [automated] alert rule added: rtx8000-sa-scl-1-fan-temp (warn 80%, critical 94%).

min.park: Runbook snippet for teams:
```
# reserve (preview)
rcli reserve --region sa-scl-1 --gpu RTX8000 --count 2 --days 10
# check pool status
rcli pool status --name dedicated-rtx8000-sa-scl-1-01
# cancel (24h fee applies)
rcli reserve cancel --id <reservation-id>
```

sales-latam: OK, we'll flag offers as "preview access" and route signup to eng for onboarding.

alejandro.mora: We'll share a short utilization update in 48h and decide on burst/autoscale policy. Ping me for escalations. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
